full_script: [thoughtful] Frases reales, de las que se usan de verdad. Dilas antes que yo. Downtown, please. How long does it take? How much is it to the airport? Pull over here, please. Keep the change. Which bus goes to the beach? Is this my stop? A round-trip ticket. Does this train go to London? I'm in a hurry. [excited] Compártelo con alguien que las necesite.
